<!-- wp:html --><style id="psg-hp-css">.psg-hp{--navy:#0F172A;--ink:#1E293B;--slate:#334155;--muted:#64748B;--line:#E2E8F0;--soft:#F8FAFC;--blue:#1D4ED8;--blue2:#2563EB;--b50:#EFF6FF;--green:#16A34A}
.psg-hp,.psg-hp *{box-sizing:border-box}
.psg-hp{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--slate);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.psg-hp h1,.psg-hp h2,.psg-hp h3{font-family:"Space Grotesk",Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0}
.psg-hp a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.psg-hp .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.psg-hp .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:600;font-size:15.5px}
.psg-hp .btn-p{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(29,78,216,.25)}
.psg-hp .btn-s{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid #CBD5E1}
.psg-hp .kick{display:inline-block;font:700 12.5px Inter;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.psg-hp .hero{background:radial-gradient(1200px 500px at 85% -10%,#EFF6FF,transparent),radial-gradient(#E2E8F0 1px,transparent 1px) 0 0/22px 22px;padding:72px 0 64px}
.psg-hp .hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.psg-hp .pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--b50);color:var(--blue);border:1px solid #BFDBFE;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.psg-hp .hero h1{font-size:54px;line-height:1.05;margin:18px 0 14px}
.psg-hp .tagline{font:700 21px "Space Grotesk";color:var(--blue2);margin:0 0 14px}
.psg-hp .hero p.lead{font-size:18.5px;line-height:1.6;max-width:560px;margin:0 0 26px}
.psg-hp .ctas{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.psg-hp .trust{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.psg-hp .trust span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.psg-hp .trust svg{color:var(--green)}
.psg-hp .hero-art{width:100%;height:auto}
.psg-hp section{padding:80px 0}
.psg-hp .sh{max-width:720px;margin:0 0 36px}
.psg-hp .sh h2{font-size:36px;line-height:1.15;margin:8px 0 10px}
.psg-hp .sh p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}
.psg-hp .center{text-align:center;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.psg-hp .pillars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.psg-hp .pl{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:26px;background:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:.2s}
.psg-hp .pl:hover{border-color:#BFDBFE;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.07)}
.psg-hp .pl .ic{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--b50);color:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}
.psg-hp .pl h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:8px}
.psg-hp .pl p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 16px}
.psg-hp .pl ul{list-style:none;padding:14px 0 0;margin:auto 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14.5px}
.psg-hp .pl li{margin:0 0 8px}
.psg-hp .pl li a{color:var(--ink)}
.psg-hp .pl li a:hover{color:var(--blue)}
.psg-hp .pl .go{margin-top:8px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue);font-size:14.5px}
.psg-hp .journey{background:var(--navy);border-radius:28px;padding:56px;color:#CBD5E1}
.psg-hp .journey h2{color:#fff}
.psg-hp .journey .kick{color:#93C5FD}
.psg-hp .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:16px;counter-reset:s;position:relative}
.psg-hp .st{background:#1E293B;border-radius:16px;padding:22px;position:relative}
.psg-hp .st .n{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 15px Inter;margin-bottom:14px}
.psg-hp .st h3{color:#fff;font-size:18px;margin-bottom:6px}
.psg-hp .st p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 14px}
.psg-hp .st a{color:#93C5FD;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.psg-hp .grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}
.psg-hp .pc{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.psg-hp .pc:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.08)}
.psg-hp .pc-img{aspect-ratio:1200/630;background:var(--b50);overflow:hidden}
.psg-hp .pc-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.psg-hp .pc-b{padding:20px 22px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
.psg-hp .tag{font:700 11.5px Inter;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:8px}
.psg-hp .pc h3{font-size:18.5px;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:8px}
.psg-hp .pc p{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--muted)}
.psg-hp .more{margin-top:auto;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue);font-size:14.5px}
.psg-hp .soft{background:var(--soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.psg-hp .disc{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:22px}
.psg-hp .tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:16px}
.psg-hp .tl{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.psg-hp .tl .t{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.psg-hp .tl h3{font-size:19px;margin:4px 0 8px}
.psg-hp .tl p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 16px}
.psg-hp .tl .a1{display:block;text-align:center;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;margin-top:auto}
.psg-hp .tl .a2{display:block;text-align:center;border:1px solid #CBD5E1;border-radius:10px;padding:9px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--navy);margin-top:8px}
.psg-hp .tl .a2.only{margin-top:auto}
.psg-hp .badge{display:inline-block;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--green);background:#F0FDF4;border:1px solid #BBF7D0;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 8px;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle}
.psg-hp .trustg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.2fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.psg-hp .tp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.psg-hp .ti{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px}
.psg-hp .ti .ic{color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:10px}
.psg-hp .ti h3{font-size:17px;margin-bottom:6px}
.psg-hp .ti p{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;margin:0}
.psg-hp .author{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin-top:22px;padding:16px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--b50)}
.psg-hp .av{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3B82F6,#1D4ED8);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 20px "Space Grotesk"}
.psg-hp .lawband{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EFF6FF,#fff);border:1px solid #BFDBFE;border-radius:24px;padding:36px 40px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:24px}
.psg-hp .lawband h2{font-size:28px;margin:6px 0 8px}
.psg-hp .lawband p{margin:0;font-size:16px}
.psg-hp .faq{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto}
.psg-hp .fq{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 22px;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);font-size:16.5px}
.psg-hp .final{background:var(--navy);border-radius:28px;padding:56px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;color:#CBD5E1}
.psg-hp .final h2{color:#fff;font-size:34px;margin-bottom:10px}
.psg-hp .form{background:#1E293B;border-radius:18px;padding:24px}
.psg-hp .form h3{color:#fff;font-size:18px;margin-bottom:6px}
.psg-hp .form p{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 14px}
.psg-hp .form .in{background:#0F172A;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:10px;padding:13px;color:#64748B;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:10px}
.psg-hp .form .sb{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;text-align:center;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:1000px){.psg-hp .hero .wrap,.psg-hp .trustg,.psg-hp .final{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.psg-hp .pillars{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.psg-hp .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.psg-hp .tools{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.psg-hp .grid3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

@media(max-width:640px){.psg-hp .hero{padding:40px 0}
.psg-hp .hero h1{font-size:38px}
.psg-hp .tagline{font-size:18px}
.psg-hp .hero p.lead{font-size:16.5px}
.psg-hp section{padding:52px 0}
.psg-hp .sh h2{font-size:28px}
.psg-hp .pillars,.psg-hp .steps,.psg-hp .tools,.psg-hp .grid3,.psg-hp .tp{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.psg-hp .journey,.psg-hp .final{padding:32px 22px;border-radius:22px}
.psg-hp .lawband{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;padding:26px}
.psg-hp .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}}

.psg-hp .hv{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:560px;aspect-ratio:560/470;margin-left:auto}
.psg-hp .hv *{box-sizing:border-box}
.psg-hp .hv-blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(2px)}
.psg-hp .hv-blob.b1{width:72%;height:80%;right:2%;top:6%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%,#DBEAFE,#EFF6FF 60%,transparent 70%)}
.psg-hp .hv-blob.b2{width:38%;height:40%;left:0;bottom:2%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#E0E7FF,transparent 70%)}
.psg-hp .hv-browser{position:absolute;left:9%;top:11%;width:78%;background:#fff;border:1px solid #E2E8F0;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(15,23,42,.25),0 8px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.06);overflow:hidden}
.psg-hp .hv-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:11px 14px;background:#F8FAFC;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F7}
.psg-hp .hv-bar i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#CBD5E1}.psg-hp .hv-bar i:first-child{background:#FCA5A5}.psg-hp .hv-bar i:nth-child(2){background:#FCD34D}.psg-hp .hv-bar i:nth-child(3){background:#86EFAC}
.psg-hp .hv-url{margin-left:10px;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #E2E8F0;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 10px;font:600 11px Inter,sans-serif;color:#334155}
.psg-hp .hv-site{padding:14px 16px 16px}
.psg-hp .hv-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}.psg-hp .hv-nav span{height:6px;width:26px;border-radius:3px;background:#E2E8F0}.psg-hp .hv-nav .hv-logo{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3B82F6,#1D4ED8);margin-right:auto}.psg-hp .hv-nav .hv-cta{width:38px;height:14px;border-radius:5px;background:#0F172A}
.psg-hp .hv-heroin{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
.psg-hp .hv-copy b{display:block;height:11px;width:92%;border-radius:4px;background:#0F172A;margin-bottom:6px}.psg-hp .hv-copy b.s{width:70%}
.psg-hp .hv-copy em{display:block;height:6px;width:96%;border-radius:3px;background:#CBD5E1;margin:9px 0 0}.psg-hp .hv-copy em.s{width:76%;margin-top:5px}
.psg-hp .hv-btns{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}.psg-hp .hv-btns u{height:16px;width:52px;border-radius:5px;background:#1D4ED8}.psg-hp .hv-btns u.o{background:#fff;border:1px solid #CBD5E1;width:44px}
.psg-hp .hv-img{aspect-ratio:3/2;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#EFF6FF,#DBEAFE);overflow:hidden}.psg-hp .hv-img svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.psg-hp .hv-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}.psg-hp .hv-cards div{border:1px solid #EEF2F7;border-radius:9px;padding:9px;background:#FBFDFF}
.psg-hp .hv-cards span{display:block;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:5px;background:#DBEAFE;margin-bottom:7px}.psg-hp .hv-cards div:nth-child(2) span{background:#DCFCE7}.psg-hp .hv-cards div:nth-child(3) span{background:#FEF3C7}
.psg-hp .hv-cards em{display:block;height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:#CBD5E1;width:90%}.psg-hp .hv-cards em.s{width:60%;margin-top:5px;background:#E2E8F0}
.psg-hp .hv-f{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #E2E8F0;border-radius:14px;padding:10px 14px;box-shadow:0 18px 36px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.22);font-family:Inter,sans-serif}
.psg-hp .hv-f strong{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#0F172A;line-height:1.2}.psg-hp .hv-f small{display:block;font-size:11.5px;color:#64748B;margin-top:2px}.psg-hp .hv-f small.g{color:#16A34A;font-weight:600}
.psg-hp .hv-speed{right:0;top:2%;padding:8px 14px 8px 8px}
.psg-hp .hv-domain{left:0;top:56%}.psg-hp .hv-domain .ok{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#16A34A;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.psg-hp .hv-search{left:3%;bottom:0;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:8px;width:46%}
.psg-hp .hv-search .q{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:1px solid #E2E8F0;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11.5px;color:#334155}
.psg-hp .hv-search .r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.psg-hp .hv-search .pos{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:#1D4ED8;color:#fff;font:800 12px Inter;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.psg-hp .hv-traffic{right:1%;bottom:6%;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px;background:#0F172A;border-color:#0F172A;padding:12px 14px}.psg-hp .hv-traffic small{color:#93C5FD;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:10.5px;margin:0}
.psg-hp .hv-wp{left:-1%;top:4%}.psg-hp .hv-wp .wp{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#EFF6FF;border:2px solid #1D4ED8;color:#1D4ED8;font:800 15px Georgia,serif;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
@media(max-width:1000px){.psg-hp .hv{margin:10px auto 0}}
@media(max-width:560px){.psg-hp .hv{aspect-ratio:560/520}.psg-hp .hv-f{padding:7px 10px;gap:7px;border-radius:11px}.psg-hp .hv-f strong{font-size:11px}.psg-hp .hv-f small{font-size:9.5px}.psg-hp .hv-speed svg{width:40px;height:40px}.psg-hp .hv-traffic svg{width:120px;height:46px}.psg-hp .hv-search{width:54%}.psg-hp .hv-wp .wp,.psg-hp .hv-domain .ok{width:24px;height:24px}}
@media(max-width:640px){.psg-hp .hv{aspect-ratio:560/430}.psg-hp .hv-wp,.psg-hp .hv-search{display:none}.psg-hp .hv-browser{left:4%;width:88%;top:12%}.psg-hp .hv-domain{top:auto;bottom:4%;left:0}.psg-hp .hv-traffic{bottom:14%}}

.psg-hp{background:#fff}.psg-hp h1,.psg-hp h2,.psg-hp h3{font-family:"Space Grotesk",Inter,sans-serif}
.psg-hp a{text-decoration:none}.psg-hp p{margin-top:0}
.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px}
.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest li{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin:0!important;width:auto!important;padding:0 0 22px}
.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest li:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.08)}
.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest .wp-block-latest-posts__featured-image{margin:0 0 16px;aspect-ratio:1200/630;overflow:hidden;background:var(--b50)}
.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest .wp-block-latest-posts__featured-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest .wp-block-latest-posts__post-title{display:block;padding:0 22px;font:700 18.5px/1.3 "Space Grotesk",Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:8px}
.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest .wp-block-latest-posts__post-excerpt{padding:0 22px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest .wp-block-latest-posts__post-excerpt a{color:var(--blue);font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:1000px){.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:640px){.psg-hp .psg-hp-latest{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.psg-hp details.fqd{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:12px;background:#fff}
.psg-hp details.fqd summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:18px 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);font-size:16.5px}
.psg-hp details.fqd summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.psg-hp details.fqd[open] summary span{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.psg-hp .fqa{padding:0 22px 18px;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.6}.psg-hp .fqa a{color:var(--blue);text-decoration:underline}
.psg-hp .form .sb{color:#fff}.psg-hp .sr{position:absolute;left:-9999px}
.psg-hp .hsearch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #CBD5E1;border-radius:14px;padding:6px 6px 6px 16px;max-width:580px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.18)}
.psg-hp .hsearch:focus-within{border-color:#2563EB;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(37,99,235,.12)}
.psg-hp .hsearch input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0!important;outline:0;background:transparent!important;font:500 16px Inter,sans-serif;color:#0F172A;padding:12px 0!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.psg-hp .hsearch button{background:#1D4ED8;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:13px 20px;font:600 15.5px Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.psg-hp .hsearch button:hover{background:#1E40AF}
.psg-hp .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;color:#64748B}
.psg-hp .chips a{border:1px solid #E2E8F0;background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 13px;color:#1E293B;font-size:14px}.psg-hp .chips a:hover{border-color:#93C5FD;color:#1D4ED8}
.psg-hp .alt{margin:14px 0 0;font-size:14.5px;color:#64748B}.psg-hp .alt a{color:#1D4ED8;font-weight:600}
.psg-hp .ansec{padding:0 0 72px;margin-top:-24px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.psg-hp .acard{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E2E8F0;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(15,23,42,.25);overflow:hidden}
.psg-hp .abar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:12px 16px;background:#F8FAFC;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF2F7}.psg-hp .abar i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#CBD5E1}
.psg-hp .aurl{margin-left:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #E2E8F0;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:13px;color:#334155;min-width:280px}
.psg-hp .agrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.05fr;gap:40px;padding:32px}
.psg-hp .aleft h2{font-size:30px;line-height:1.2;margin:10px 0 12px}.psg-hp .aleft p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 16px}
.psg-hp .atags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:18px}.psg-hp .atags span{background:#F1F5F9;border-radius:10px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:13.5px;color:#334155}
.psg-hp .alink{color:#1D4ED8;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
